DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0048 2026-10-21
MEETING NOTES — Source Index Access After the Queue
Binder Transfer
Date: 2026-10-21
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Attendees: PERSON-0033 for TEAM-0003; DEMO-STATION-01 source
clerk; DEMO-STATION-03 receiving coordinator; program records
editor.
Purpose: Agree how later reference questions reach the correct
desk after the queue-paper transfer arrangement for
DEMO-AIR-0012. ISSUE-0099 and TASK-0263 locate the avionics
section used in this discussion.
Decisions The source station retains its source index and
transfer receipt from the arrangement scheduled for 2026-09-01
at 09:40. The receiving station is the destination for
binder-access requests after the documented handover. This
division concerns custody of papers, not an aircraft location
change.
A request must say whether the sender needs a source-copy
lookup or access to the receiving binder. The source clerk
answers index-location questions and directs binder requests
using the receiving contact recorded on the receipt. Keep the
original request with any redirection note so the requesting
desk can follow the route.
The records editor will add the source heading and receiving
index heading to the transfer reference sheet. Do not create a
second working binder at the source station merely to avoid
asking the receiving desk.
Action items
_ owner: Source clerk. Due: 2026-10-22. Confirm the retained
D. Worker 0033
Demo Worker 0033, Demo Team 03
